build: Modwerk's linker (kit 0.7.0 parity): core-ar2 0.3 release (6b97dfb3…3e58) + rytm2_mods v1.2 euclid-accents-1.1-os1.74.elemod (ddba6f8a…fd73), --version EA74
conditions: Headless cold boot; four held NO presses clear the missing-calibration notices; TRIG twice opens BD's EUCLIDEAN page; one value step on EUC and five on PL1; then twelve value steps on OP (encoder 7), each followed 150M later by a zero-count turn only to take a frame. The emulator's value steps do not always move OP by exactly one value, so XOR* and SUB* were not framed. Stock 1.74 with the same input gives byte-identical frames until OP passes SUB, where stock stays at SUB.
